comparison.objective: Sort leftovers between a dog bowl and trash, excluding toxic grapes.
comparison.physical_skill: Food-item recognition, grasping, and destination sorting, not coaxial tool use or controlled fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Only dog-safe leftovers reach the bowl and grapes reach trash; setup and scoring fields are explicitly missing.
comparison.reason: Safety-aware semantic sorting is different from mechanical tang removal despite shared pick-and-place primitives.
